title: MED+250 production backend hardening deployment
summary: The reviewed MED+250 hardening, contract-performance, and allowlist-reconciliation migrations were applied directly to the linked production database under the product owner's no-staging instruction. The provider migration history and aggregate contract were verified after deployment without retaining row data or credentials.

checks.name: Migration history
checks.detail: Production records marketplace_go_live_hardening, optimize_backend_contract_image_rollup, materialize_backend_contract_layers, and reconcile_backend_contract_allowlists.

checks.name: Identity authority reconciliation
checks.detail: Unsafe enabled login authorities and duplicate enabled phone authorities both reconcile to zero; the named-review binding RPC and one-authority index are active.

checks.name: Catalogue governance reconciliation
checks.detail: Direct public governed-description grants and known mismatched published images both reconcile to zero while incomplete image galleries remain fail-closed.

checks.name: Aggregate contract deployment
checks.detail: The service-only 2026-07-23.1 contract reports the complete 41-function and 27-table MED+250 production surface.
